fusions.name: Two-Fist Quake
fusions.desc: Brings both fists down on the ground, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Whatever's to Hand
fusions.desc: Hurls a stone that deals 30 damage to the first enemy in its path. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Found a Bigger Rock
fusions.desc: Increases your blunt damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Roused Silverback
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, your physical damage rises 40% for 8 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
